claude.sample_unit: institutional patient education materials on lateral epicondylitis

links.outcome: Reading grade level of patient education materials before vs after ChatGPT rewriting to eighth-grade target
links.effect: Mean grade level fell from 9.81 ± 1.76 to 6.12 ± 0.97, a reduction of 3.70 ± 1.84 grade levels (p<0.001); only 6 originals were below eighth grade versus all rewritten.
links.quote: By utilising ChatGPT to rewrite the original PEMs, a reduction of 3.70 ± 1.84 (p<0.001) reading grade levels and 346.72 ± 364.63 (p<0.001) words was achieved (Table 2 ).

links.outcome: Readability of patient education materials after generative AI plain-language rewriting
links.effect: All rewritten PEMs scored below eighth-grade level; average readability 6.12 ± 0.97 versus 9.81 ± 1.76 originally; word count fell from 600.68 to 253.96.
links.quote: Following ChatGPT’s edits to the original PEMs, all 25 rewritten PEMs obtained average readability scores below the eighth-grade reading level.

links.outcome: Rewritten PEM readability and word count
links.effect: Rewritten PEMs averaged 6.12 ± 0.97 grade level and 253.96 ± 100.76 words.
links.quote: The total average readability score for all rewritten PEMs was 6.12 ± 0.97 (Figure 1 ), with an average word count of 253.96 ± 100.76 (Figure 2 ).

links.outcome: Readability grade level and word count reduction
links.effect: Reading grade levels fell 3.70 ± 1.84 and word count fell 346.72 ± 364.63; both p<0.001.
links.quote: By utilising ChatGPT to rewrite the original PEMs, a reduction of 3.70 ± 1.84 (p<0.001) reading grade levels and 346.72 ± 364.63 (p<0.001) words was achieved (Table 2 ).

links.outcome: readability grade level of patient educational materials
links.effect: Reading grade level decreased by 3.70 ± 1.84 (p<0.001) and word count decreased by 346.72 ± 364.63 (p<0.001)
links.quote: Analysis of the original and edited PEMs about LE revealed significant reductions in reading grade level and word count of 3.70 ± 1.84 (p<0.001) and 346.72 ± 364.63 (p<0.001), respectively.

links.outcome: reading level of patient educational materials meeting eighth-grade guideline
links.effect: All 25 rewritten PEMs scored below eighth-grade reading level (mean 6.12 ± 0.97) compared to 6 of original PEMs (mean 9.81 ± 1.76)
links.quote: Following ChatGPT’s edits to the original PEMs, all 25 rewritten PEMs obtained average readability scores below the eighth-grade reading level.
